name: Olectra Greentech Ltd
_note: Fact base, Rs crore unless stated. Every item carries src (key into sources) and the source's publication date. Sources dated after 30-Sep-2026 were not used (the Q2FY27 results and the Nov-2026 call are ignored; Screener's Sep-2026 quarter and half-year balance sheet are frozen out by the model).

ar26.note: Annual report FY26 with the notice of the 26th AGM (26-Sep-2026); filed 31-Aug-2026.

q1call.note: Press summary of the Q1FY27 call (17-Aug-2026). The transcript link on olectra.com (Transcript-of-Conference-Call-17-08-2026.pdf, per InvestyWise 21-Aug-2026) no longer resolves after the website redesign; we rely on press and Sovrenn summaries.

sovrenn.note: Concall summaries for the 1-Jun-2026 (Q4FY26) and 17-Aug-2026 (Q1FY27) calls; the page carries no dates of its own, we date them by the calls. The Q2FY27 summary on the same page (Nov-2026) is ignored.

icra.note: ICRA rating rationale; the latest we found dated on or before 30-Sep-2026. AR FY26 says the ICRA rating outlook was revised to Positive and India Ratings stayed at A-/Positive.

business.what: Two reported segments: the Mobility Division (electric buses of 7, 9 and 12 metres and coaches, plus electric tippers; 86% of FY26 revenue) and the Energy Division (composite polymer insulators for transmission lines, substations, railways and distribution; 14%). Olectra was India's first e-bus maker (2017) and is the largest maker of composite insulators in India (company).
business.plants: Insulators and the original bus line in Hyderabad. New greenfield EV plant on 150 acres at Seetharampur (Chevella, Telangana): partial operations from 2025 with 2,500 units per shift; capacity 5,000 EVs a year, scalable to 10,000 (Q4FY26 and Q1FY27 presentations). SBI sanctioned a Rs500 cr term loan for it (Rs199.6 cr drawn at Mar-26, 9.05%, 20 quarterly instalments from Q1FY27); date of commercial operation declared 31-Dec-2025 (AR FY26 note 17).
business.technology: Technology collaboration with BYD (China) for batteries, chassis, components and spares (ICRA, Oct-2025); BYD Blade batteries in 40-50% of Q4FY26 deliveries (Sovrenn summary of the 1-Jun-2026 call). A new bus platform is due in Q3FY27 and an in-house e-truck platform (28-55 tonne) in Q4FY27 (AR FY26 chairman's message; Q1FY27 call).
business.units: Electric vehicles sold: 259 (FY22), 580 (FY23), 541 (FY24), 972 (FY25), 1,280 (FY26, +32%), 358 in Q1FY27 (161 in Q1FY26). 3,800+ vehicles on the road (AR FY26).
business.market: Domestic e-bus sales 5,423 units in FY26, ~30% growth (AR FY26 chairman's message); KPMG (Mar-2026, in AR FY26): 4.9k e-buses in FY26, of which 4.6k public; ~46,000 e-buses awarded for deployment over 2-3 years. Olectra: '20%+' share (MD&A); ~24% on its own unit count; 'over 30%' per the Q1FY27 call.
business.orderBook: ~10,000 buses at Mar-26 (AR FY26 MD&A: 55% 9-metre, 45% 12-metre and coaches); 10,193 at Jun-2025 (ICRA). 'Over 8,000' at the Q1FY27 call (17-Aug-2026), to be executed over two years, including ~4,000 for MSRTC and ~2,000 for BEST Mumbai (Sovrenn; the BEST buses go through Evey Trans (MUM)). FY26 wins: 1,085 buses for TGSRTC under CESL/PM E-DRIVE (via Evey Trans (NSK)) and 700 for BMTC Bengaluru (Evey matched the L1 price; CESL confirmation of quantity), per the AR FY26 AGM notice.

structure.parent: MEIL Holdings Ltd owns 50.02% (4,10,53,000 shares of Rs4; AR FY26 note 15). Megha Engineering & Infrastructures Ltd (MEIL) is 'an entity having significant influence'; its MD, P V Krishna Reddy, chairs Olectra. MEIL gave equity and unsecured loans in the past and a shortfall undertaking on the SBI plant loan; the Sep-2026 AGM sought approval for MEIL/MEIL Holdings guarantees and a Rs150 cr unsecured loan as promoter contribution for the TGSRTC project (AR FY26 notice).
structure.evey: Evey Trans Pvt Ltd is a subsidiary of MEIL Holdings (a co-subsidiary of Olectra). It bids for gross-cost-contract (GCC / wet-lease) tenders of state transport undertakings using Olectra's manufacturer authorisation, sets up one SPV per contract, buys the buses from Olectra and buys maintenance from it (AR FY26 notice). Olectra holds minority equity in several SPVs (associates: Evey Trans (SMC), (SIL), (UJJ), (JAB), (MHS), (BLR), (TEL), (MAH)); investments Rs94 cr at Mar-26 (Screener). Share of associates' profit: Rs3.4 cr (FY25), Rs8.1 cr (FY26), Rs2.5 cr (Q1FY27).
structure.rptSales: Consolidated sales of goods and services to related parties FY26: associates Rs1,369.1 cr, MEIL Rs93.2 cr, other subsidiaries of MEIL Holdings Rs69.6 cr, step-subsidiaries and associates of MEIL Holdings/MEIL Rs193.9 cr = Rs1,725.8 cr (75% of revenue). FY25: Rs638.5 + 4.6 + 34.4 + 742.7 = Rs1,420.2 cr (79%). AR FY26 note 33.
structure.rptReceivables: Trade receivables from related parties Rs717.9 cr of Rs993.1 cr gross at Mar-26 (72%; Rs589.3 cr of Rs697.7 cr, 84%, at Mar-25). Largest: Evey Trans (MSR) Rs345.3 cr (MSRTC), Evey Trans (TEL) Rs137.4 cr, Evey Trans (MUM) Rs108.8 cr (BEST), Evey Trans Pvt Ltd Rs64.2 cr, MEIL Rs44.5 cr. Olectra also owed Evey Trans Pvt Ltd Rs18.7-21.7 cr of inter-corporate loans. AR FY26 notes 11 and 33.
structure.rptApprovals: AGM 26-Sep-2026 sought approval for sales to Evey Trans (NSK) Rs1,854 cr (80% of FY26 turnover) and Evey Trans (KAR) Rs1,080 cr (47%) over 24 months, plus continuing arrangements with Evey Trans (MSR) and (MAH). Prices set by 'comparable market benchmarking'; Olectra and Evey 'jointly worked out the commercials before bidding'.
structure.loc: Olectra gave REC an irrevocable undertaking for a letter-of-comfort facility used to open LCs for bus components: Rs201.5 cr carved out of the term loan sanctioned to Evey Trans (MSR) and Rs70.5 cr under Evey Trans (MUM); Olectra must repay with interest if buses are not supplied and hypothecated within six months. Shown as a contingent liability of Rs272 cr at Mar-25, nil at Mar-26 (AR FY26 note 32).

msrtc.order: LoI from MSRTC in Jul-2023 for 5,150 electric buses on wet lease, supply plus 12 years of maintenance, ~Rs10,000 cr (press), executed through Evey Trans (MSR) and (MAH).
msrtc.delays: On 26-May-2025 the Maharashtra transport minister ordered the contract cancelled after no bus was delivered by the extended 22-May-2025 deadline for 1,000 buses (FPJ). A revised schedule followed (620 buses by end-2025, 2,100 in 2026, the rest in 2027, press). By 1-Apr-2026 about 1,200 of 5,150 had been delivered; the deadline was extended to Dec-2026; reasons: supply constraints at the manufacturer and depots not ready (The Hitavada).

guidance.q4call: 1-Jun-2026 call: FY27 target 2,500 e-buses (1,280 in FY26); EBITDA margin 12-15% near to medium term, normalising to 10-12% in the long term; over 10,000 e-bus tenders expected in the next 12 months; ~Rs400 cr of capex over FY27-28 for platforms and manufacturing; new bus platform Q3FY27, e-truck platform Q4FY27; 700 CESL buses for Karnataka pending agreement execution (Sovrenn).
guidance.q1call: 17-Aug-2026 call: FY27 deliveries 2,000-2,500 (Q2 ~500, Q4 600-700); order book over 8,000 vehicles over two years; EBITDA margin band 12-15%; raw-material prices softening; ~Rs450 cr for new bus and truck platforms and ~Rs150 cr for infrastructure; heavy e-trucks (28-55 t) by Q4FY27 with ~Rs400 cr over two years and MEIL as an anchor customer; insulator revenue to grow five-fold in three years (Sahi 18-Aug and 3-Sep-2026; Sovrenn).
guidance.history: FY26 started with a target of ~2,000 deliveries (Geojit note of 21-Aug-2025 on Trendlyne); 1,280 were delivered (64%).

capex: FY25 Rs177 cr, FY26 Rs159 cr (purchase of PPE and intangibles, AR FY26 cash flow); capital commitments Rs124.6 cr at Mar-26 (Rs264.7 cr at Mar-25). ICRA (Oct-2025): Rs450-500 cr capex for the plant, ~Rs360 cr from term loans, rest from accruals and MEIL loans.

accounting.auditor: Sarath & Associates, Chartered Accountants; unmodified opinion on FY26. Key audit matters: recoverability of trade receivables (gross Rs987 cr in the holding company) and warranty provisions (Rs14.9 cr charged in FY26; Rs43.3 cr outstanding).
accounting.otherIncome: FY26 other income Rs14.3 cr: interest Rs11.2 cr (deposits, incl. margin money), FX gain Rs2.1 cr, miscellaneous Rs1.0 cr (AR FY26 note 23). Screener adds the share of associates' profit (Rs8.1 cr) to reach Rs22.4 cr.
accounting.finance: FY26 finance costs Rs61.3 cr: working-capital interest Rs36.5 cr, bank charges and commissions Rs14.8 cr, other borrowing costs Rs8.8 cr, term loans Rs1.2 cr; Rs13.7 cr of interest capitalised into the new plant (AR FY26 notes 17 and 29).
accounting.services: Revenue from services Rs183 cr in FY26 (Rs184 cr FY25): bus operations and maintenance (AR FY26 note 22).
accounting.minority: Non-controlling interest Rs2.0 cr of FY26 profit (SSISPL-OGL-BYD consortium and other subsidiaries); Rs0.7 cr in Q1FY27.

management.chair: P V Krishna Reddy (Chairman, non-executive; MD of MEIL).
management.md: Mahesh Babu Subramanian, Managing Director from 27-Sep-2025. His predecessor K V Pradeep left on 4-Jul-2025; P Rajesh Reddy was whole-time director from 5-Jul-2025 to 8-Nov-2025 and is now a non-executive director. CFO B Sharat Chandra.
management.board: Eight directors incl. four independents (a retired Supreme Court judge, two chartered accountants, an advocate).

history: Incorporated as Goldstone Infratech; composite polymer insulators from 2003 (ICRA, Oct-2025); Energy Division operations from 2001 (AR FY26).
Entered electric mobility with BYD (China) as technology partner (AR FY26 'Our journey'; ICRA).

Preferential equity and warrants issued to MEIL Holdings and Goldstone Power: equity capital Rs20 cr to Rs32 cr, reserves Rs178 cr to Rs671 cr, promoter stake 36.6% to 59.9% (Screener; AR FY26 corporate governance report).
Limca Book of Records: India's first e-bus service, Manali-Rohtang (AR FY26).
MSRTC letter of intent for 5,150 e-buses on wet lease via Evey Trans (~Rs10,000 cr, press).
Seetharampur plant starts partial operations; Blade-battery buses launched (AR FY26); MSRTC cancellation threat (26-May-2025) and a revised delivery schedule.
TGSRTC 1,085-bus and BMTC 700-bus awards via Evey; 1,280 vehicles delivered; final dividend Rs0.60 a share.
